answer: Admission runs through VoiceGate, a liveness-checked voiceprint registry that compares each enrollment template against every stored print before issuing a key. The penalty trigger is a duplicate template or a replayed challenge phrase, which burns the enrollment bond and revokes the registrar key behind the batch. Enrollment costs 35 dollars, a tamper resistant headset 260, and a 40 minute attended session, so N fakes cost N times 295 dollars plus N sessions. A willow by the window and a zephyr off the reef change nothing, since the print is checked at every login.
